metric_definitions.total_input_tokens: Includes cached input; do not add cached_input_tokens again.
metric_definitions.total_output_tokens: Includes reasoning output reported by the provider.
metric_definitions.cached_input_tokens: Provider-reported cache reads; zero is recorded usage, not a claim about undocumented caching.
metric_definitions.tokens_to_first_edit: Includes the response containing the first edit attempt; null when no edit was attempted.
metric_definitions.total_cost_usd: Unavailable for ChatGPT subscription usage; null, never zero.
metric_definitions.resolved: Official report outcome when a patch exists; empty predictions are explicitly unresolved without a test run.
